name: Gohoushi Kissa ~Tenshi-tachi ni Omakase~ Kaori Hen
original_name: ご奉仕喫茶～天使達におまかせ～ かおり編
source:
Kazuya works at a custume play cafe. He loves Kaori but he actually loves a girl, appears in his dream, who resembles Kaori. He lives day by day trying not to be noticed his secret. Swaying his emotion and her emotion.... What will happen at the end...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328190826/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1004204]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
和也在一家角色扮演咖啡馆工作。
他爱着香绪里，却也爱着一个在梦中出现、与香绪里十分相似的女孩。
他日复一日地生活，努力不让人察觉这个秘密。
心绪随自己与她的感情摇摆……结局会怎样？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328190826/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1004204]Eroge Shop[/url]]
